variant_decisions.evidence: Qere שָׁפְכוּ (3mp) and ketiv שפכה (3fs) differ only in verbal agreement with the plural/dual subject יָדֵינוּ; a feminine singular verb with a dual subject is ordinary Hebrew concord. ASV 'Our hands have not shed this blood' renders the same clause either way, since English supplies plural agreement with 'hands' regardless, and there is no ASV note at this word. Nothing in the English distinguishes the two, so the qere base fallback carries the projection.
